chordErrorQualification: Authored guide centreline samples before root laying; final coverage centreline samples reported separately. No continuous or final surface bound.

scalpAllowlist.earExclusion: Below y1.535, allow only rear x within +/-0.064 and z<=-0.02; no lateral temple/ear roots

cardFrame.method: uneven-row central derivatives; per-column cross derivative

material.cardFrame: Baked uneven-row derivatives; interpolated in view space; same frame for normal and lighting

rootTransition.qualification: Authored appearance trial, not reference-derived measurements

castShadows.lights: existing key/fill; positions, colours and intensities unchanged
castShadows.scope: Directional card/head occlusion; no scatter, pigment, geometry or face-lighting edits
castShadows.kernel: 5x5 grid at two-texel spacing; separable weights 1,2,3,2,1; sum81
castShadows.qualification: Fixed shadow-space blur; not physical area-light penumbra; render cost not benchmarked

indirect.model: pigment-weighted Lambert proxy: irradiance * lock colour / pi * root occlusion * ambient occlusion
indirect.scope: local component only; shared shader unchanged
indirect.qualification: Appearance trial; not integrated fibre multiple scattering or environment specular

waveRoughness.preservation: All geometry buffers, pigment, alpha, hairline, ends, ambient, lighting, shadow settings and approved features fixed
waveRoughness.qualification: Local roughness study only; unresolved variation fades to baseline mean

qualification: Rendered development draft. Clearance and corrected root winding are reported defects, not waived acceptance criteria. No appearance, motion or complete-character acceptance.
